318:t_000:18.en:
$$ナミ$$
「It's not in bad taste, but... doesn't a white base color look kind of weak?」

318:t_000:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's the color of the machine I used to pilot. It isn't weak at all. And it's lucky.」

318:t_000:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「It is. I'll take the liberty of calling this machine '$$アル二世$$.'」

318:t_000:24.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...I allowed the paint because this might be your first and last match. But as the owner, I have to reject that name.」

318:t_000:26.en:
$$ナミ$$
「And $$宗介$$, you haven't forgotten you'll be fired immediately if you don't win tonight's match, have you?」

318:t_000:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's no problem. That's what this operating test is for.」

318:t_000:29.en:
$$レモン$$
「You say that, but... it looks like you think highly of him.」

318:t_000:30.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Well, I could appreciate how he understood our machine's characteristics at a glance...」

318:t_000:31.en:
$$ナミ$$
「And... his build... He has the distinctive muscle development of an AS pilot. So...」

318:t_001:0.en:
$$ナミ$$
「That emblem on those machines...! Is it the $$オーガ$$ gang!?」

318:t_001:4.en:
$$ＡＳ乗り$$
「But it'd be a shame to see you lose miserably in front of a packed audience.」

318:t_001:5.en:
$$ＡＳ乗り$$
「We'll crush you here, where no one's watching. Then you'll just forfeit tonight's match.」

318:t_001:6.en:
$$ナミ$$
「You killed $$リック$$, and you're still pulling this...!」

318:t_001:7.en:
$$レモン$$
「And three against one is cowardly!」

318:t_002:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll have them be my practice opponents.」

318:t_002:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Though at their level, I doubt they can even serve as a warm-up.」

318:t_002:3.en:
$$ＡＴ乗り$$
「How dare lowly $$クロスボウ$$ look down on us!」

318:t_002:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$クロスボウ$$... A crossbow... That's a good name.」

318:t_002:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Though it doesn't measure up to a heavy crossbow.」

318:t_002:7.en:
$$レモン$$
「A heavy crossbow... $$アーバレスト$$...」

318:t_002:8.en:
$$ＡＳ乗り$$
「You don't know your place! We'll make you regret defying the $$オーガ一家$$!」

318:t_002:9.en:
$$ＡＳ乗り$$
「You'll regret it in the afterlife, you rank amateur!」

318:t_002:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you're trying to provoke me, learn from my friend and come up with something better.」

318:t_002:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「He'd hit simpletons like you with something vicious enough to make you explode on the spot!」

318:t_003:1.en:
$$ナミ$$
「You did it...! You did it, $$宗介$$!」

318:t_003:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's no problem. The opponents were simply too weak.」

318:t_003:3.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Haha! Now the $$オーガ$$ gang will be forfeiting tonight's match!」

318:t_003:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then... I'd like you to keep employing me, on the condition that you cover my lodging and three meals a day.」

318:t_003:5.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Of course, that's fine. I'm counting on you, $$宗介$$.」

318:t_003:6.en:
$$宗介$$
(For now, I've cleared the first stage...)

318:t_003:7.en:
$$宗介$$
(With no word on $c, I have no choice but to fight alone...)

318:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(I have no comrades... My machine is an $$Ｒｋ－９１$$ on the verge of becoming scrap...)

318:t_100:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(But I'll do it... I'll avenge $$アル$$ and rescue $$千鳥$$...)

318:t_100:2.en:
$$宗介$$
(This fight is the first step toward that...!)

323:t_1:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「H-hey, $$キリコ$$... Why don't you say something to her?」

323:t_1:8.en:
$$キリコ$$
「We don't turn anyone away here. Don't worry about anything else.」

323:t_1:10.en:
$n
「Um... I don't think $$キリコ$$'s angry or anything like that.」

323:t_1:11.en:
$n
「It's just... he isn't good at expressing his feelings, so that's the only way he can...」

323:t_1:13.en:
$$カレン$$
「It looks like you've decided to learn a little about women's feelings.」

323:t_1:14.en:
$n
「I did get advice from Miss $$スズネ$$ about how to talk to her.」

323:t_1:15.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You're doing well. It looks like you're making progress at not being the quiet type.」

323:t_1:18.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have nothing in particular to say.」

323:t_1:19.en:
$$カレン$$
「You two should be a little friendlier, too.」

323:t_1:20.en:
$n
「It's fine, $$カレン$$. $$ヒイロ$$ and $$トロワ$$ have a firm sense of self, so other people's comments don't shake them.」

323:t_1:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then are you trying hard to stop being the quiet type because you care what others say, $n?」

323:t_1:23.en:
$n
「But the biggest reason is that I wanted to change myself.」

323:t_1:24.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「You wanted to change yourself...」

323:t_1:25.en:
$$カトル$$
「$$テイタニア$$... $n used to seem much harder to approach, too.」

323:t_1:26.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「But he gradually changed. ...Though some say his flaws came out.」

323:t_1:28.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You can tell us in time what you were thinking when you left $$マーティアル$$.」

323:t_1:29.en:
$$デュオ$$
「But seeing you desperately trying to save $$キリコ$$, I could tell you're different from when you were a human weapon.」

323:t_1:30.en:
$$カレン$$
「That means you've changed, too, $$テイタニア$$.」

323:t_1:31.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Have I... managed to change, too?」

323:t_1:32.en:
$$カレン$$
「A lot has happened, but we're comrades from now on. I'm counting on you.」
